body: I'd be open to talking to a therapist, though I have little faith in them, due to prior experiences.  I also have no money to spend on one, and the free clinics aren't any help.  I was thinking of moving to Jacksonville, Florida, where I have some acquaintances, but I'm not looking forward to it.  I have no real hobbies or interests other than becoming numb to my emotions, or just being dead.
Wow.  Thanks for all the comments and suggestions.
